## About
Ron & Judy Garcia founded Reliable Energy Management with one idea in mind: energy-efficient heating and air conditioning products and services for communities across Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We work out of Walthall Way in Paramount and have repaired, serviced and installed systems in homes, apartments, condos and commercial buildings.
Sizing comes first. Before we recommend a system, our Comfort Advisors run Manual J load calculations to find how much cooling your home actually needs. An oversized unit won't adequately remove humidity and uses more energy. An undersized one struggles on hot days and can wear out more quickly. We'll also inspect your ductwork so the cooled air reaches every room.
More than just an HVAC contractor, we are a proud service provider for Southern California utility companies. Customers rate us 4.8 from 712 Google reviews.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Services: Repair and new installs for package units, ductless mini split systems, split heating and cooling systems, heat pumps and central air conditioning systems.
- Furnace and Heater Service: Heating service for homes and commercial buildings. One reviewer mentions Enrique Avila coming out to look at her furnace through a program with Socal Gas.
- VRV/F & Ductless Technology: Ductless and VRV/F systems for residential and commercial properties.
- HVAC Routine Maintenance/Tune-Up: Our 21-point Inspection and Preventative Maintenance Service Plan keeps your system comfortable and cost effective.
- Water Heater Service: Water heater service alongside our heating and cooling work.
- Attic Insulation: One reviewer said our insulation work really helped cool down her home.
- Utility Assistance Programs: We are a proud service provider for Southern California utility companies. Reviewers mention programs with SCE and Socal Gas.
- Low Income Programs: Programs listed on our site for households that need help with energy-efficient upgrades.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Communities across Orange and Los Angeles Counties, from our shop in Paramount.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We provide residential and commercial services.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
